examples.description: Move the valid-until date to 30 Sep 2026 (12:00 UTC of that date)

failure_modes.recovery: Re-read the quote and retry with the fresh updated_at; a converted quote's live document is its invoice.
failure_modes.when: expected_updated_at was passed and another writer changed the row first, or the quote is converted (a converted quote never reopens and its header no longer changes)

failure_modes.recovery: Call quote_convert with the quote id — it creates the invoice and records the link atomically.
failure_modes.when: status 'converted' or converted_invoice_id was sent by hand — both are convert-flow-owned

failure_modes.recovery: For a different scheme or pricing, create a new document with the ones you want. For the date, keep an issue_date in the same rate period or re-issue the document. Resend fx_rate_to_sgd with fx_rate_date.
failure_modes.when: tax_scheme or prices_include_tax differs from the stored value (both are fixed at creation), a new issue_date under a scheme changes the tax rate or leaves a line's tax_code without a rate, or the fx rate is malformed, comes without fx_rate_date, or is on an SGD, my_sst or scheme-less document

preconditions: Call quote_convert with the quote id — it creates the invoice and records the link atomically; status 'converted' cannot be set or left by hand, and declined quotes must be revived (status sent/accepted) before converting.

valid_until is epoch millis, and the quote prints the calendar day that instant falls on in the business time zone (sales_settings.timezone, unset = Asia/Singapore). To move the valid-until date, send 12:00 UTC of that date (30 Sep 2026 = 1790769600000): it falls on that date in every listed zone, while 00:00 UTC falls on the day before west of UTC.

description: Edits a quote's header fields and bookkeeping status (draft, sent, accepted, declined move freely). status 'converted' and converted_invoice_id are convert-flow-owned — hand-setting either refuses, and a converted quote is frozen: no status move and no header edit (it could convert again and double-bill; its invoice is the live document, so edit that). tax_scheme and prices_include_tax are fixed at creation, as is the tax rate. NEXT: quote_convert to create the invoice and record the link atomically.

expected_updated_at.description: Optional compare-and-set guard: the updated_at you last read. Mismatch returns CONFLICT with the current value.

name: quote_update
